## Why visit

A second worthwhile chop-house experience, with low ceilings, a separate restaurant atmosphere and the familiar Lowry statue at the bar. It is a useful choice when you want traditional British food and cask without leaving the central pub circuit. The room feels quite different from the ceramic spectacle of Mr Thomas’s, so the two need not be interchangeable, although a five-day trip may only need one substantial chop-house meal. Include Sam’s when the menu, table availability or Lowry connection particularly appeals.
